Name: Boss Battle
Author: Akatsuki718
Description:
Boss Battle 0.11.0 (English)
The mine entrance elevator now leads to five boss arenas. Select Boss Floors, choose a destination, and take on the fight solo or with friends. In co-op, players in the same arena share the fight. Each participating farmer still in the arena at victory earns their own reward. Boss Battle is currently in beta, with more bosses planned.
Slime King — Dodge the two knights’ charges and watch where the king lands after each leap. Your first victory earns the Slime Scepter. In single-player, use it to summon the two knights to fight alongside you or help with chopping trees, breaking rocks, and clearing debris.
Bat Lord — Watch for dives, sound waves, and bat swarms. Defeat the lord to earn a necklace that grants sonar when equipped in the hat slot. Use it to locate forage, artifact spots, and mine ladders. It can also reveal buried caches for you to dig up with your hoe.
Void Squad — Face the Void Brute, Void Marksman, and Void Shaman together. Each time one falls, the survivors enter their next phase. Defeat the squad to earn the Void Core, then hold and use it to unlock Void Travel, Void Ward, and Void Shockwave.
Crystalback Crab — Choose the Crystal Seam Chamber, follow the tracks north, then turn right into the quarry. Strike the large crystal three times with your pickaxe to awaken the crab. When it drops an ice crystal and a chunk of iron ore, break one to influence which shell it takes. Your first victory earns the Mine Crab Whistle. Use it to call a little crab that can carry up to 12 stacks of items back to your farm, once per farmer per day.
Sandworm Empress — New in 0.11.0. Choose the Ancient Sand Nest and step onto the central emblem to face the Empress. Use the pillars to block her venom, dodge the vortex and rock spikes, then strike when she collapses. Your first victory earns the Sandsong Flute, 5 Empress Scales, and the Scale Powder recipe. Play the flute to enrich powder-treated soil in a 5×5 area around you. Crops there take 25% fewer days to grow and regrow, and yield silver to iridium quality produce.
Requirements
For Stardew Valley 1.6.15. Requires SMAPI 4.1.10 or later and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later. Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 or later is optional.
Available in English and Simplified Chinese. Custom artwork was created with AI assistance. Feedback and bug reports are welcome!
Boss Battle 0.11.0（简体中文）
矿井大厅的电梯现在可以通往五个 Boss 场地。选择「Boss层」，再选想去的地图，就能独自挑战或与好友一同迎战。联机时，同一场地的玩家共享战斗进度，获胜时仍在场的参战玩家各自领取奖励。模组目前为测试版，后续会陆续加入更多 Boss。
史莱姆王 — 躲开两名骑士的冲锋，留意史莱姆王跃起后的落点。首胜可获得史莱姆权杖。单人游玩时，可以召唤这两名骑士并肩作战，也可以让它们帮忙砍树、采矿和清理杂物。
蝙蝠领主 — 留意领主的俯冲、声波和蝠群。首胜可获得回音项链，装备在帽子栏后即可使用声呐，探测附近的采集物、古物点和矿梯。在矿层中还有机会发现埋藏的宝箱，用声呐标出位置后，拿锄头就能挖出来。
虚空小队 — 同时迎战虚空狂徒、虚空狙击手和虚空萨满。每击败其中一人，幸存者都会进入下一阶段。首胜可获得虚空核心，手持并使用即可解锁虚空穿梭、虚空护体和虚空震荡。
裂晶巨蟹 — 在电梯选择「裂晶矿室」，沿矿轨向北，再向右进入采掘场。用镐子敲击中央的大晶石三次，即可唤醒巨蟹。它震落冰晶和铁矿石时，可以击碎其中一块，影响它接下来换上的矿壳。首胜可获得矿蟹哨，召来小矿蟹帮你运货。每位玩家每天可托运一次，一趟最多把 12 格背包物品送回农场。
沙虫女皇 — 0.11.0 新增。在电梯选择「古代虫巢」，走到中央纹章迎战女皇。借石柱挡住毒液，躲开龙卷风和地刺，等她力竭倒地时近身反击。首胜获得鸣沙骨笛、5 枚女皇沙鳞和麟粉配方。吹响骨笛，可将周围 5×5 格内施过麟粉的耕地变为沃土。沃土上的作物生长和再生周期缩短 25%，收获品质为银星至铱星。
前置要求
适用于《星露谷物语》1.6.15。需要 SMAPI 4.1.10 或更高版本，以及 Content Patcher 2.9.0 或更高版本。可选装 Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16.0 或更高版本，在游戏内调整设置。
支持英文和简体中文。自定义美术素材使用了 AI 辅助制作。欢迎反馈游玩体验和遇到的问题！
